facts.text: Evan suggests setting specific fitness goals, such as a certain distance to run or number of push-ups to do, to help Sam stay motivated.

evidence.quote: Set some goals, like a certain distance to run or number of push-ups to do. It'll give you something to strive for and stay motivated.

facts.text: Evan recommends finding an exercise that Sam enjoys and possibly getting a buddy for added fun and accountability.

evidence.quote: Also, try to find an exercise that you enjoy and maybe even get a buddy for extra fun and accountability.

facts.text: Sam acknowledges Evan's advice and agrees to try setting goals and finding an exercise partner to help with motivation.

evidence.quote: Yeah, that sounds like a good idea. Having goals and someone to exercise with might help. I'll give it a try!

facts.text: Evan expresses optimism that Sam will find it easier to get started with fitness over time and emphasizes the importance of feeling good and reaching goals.

evidence.quote: Getting started will get easier with time. And don't forget it's about feeling good and reaching goals, too.
